name: cc-review
description: Review the code Claude just wrote in a PR-like web UI before it commits, or a GitHub PR and its stack with comments synced both ways — comments stream back into the session so Claude can ask questions, and edits are blocked until you press Submit.

args:
import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys
config = pathlib.Path(os.environ.get("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR") or pathlib.Path.home() / ".claude")
installs = json.loads((config / "plugins" / "installed_plugins.json").read_text())["plugins"].get("cc-review@cc-review")
if not installs:
    raise SystemExit("cc-review: the cc-review@cc-review plugin is not installed")
newest = max(installs, key=lambda entry: entry.get("lastUpdated") or entry.get("installedAt") or "")
binary = str(pathlib.Path(newest["installPath"]) / "bin" / "cc-review")
subprocess.run([binary, "--version"], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
os.execv(binary, [binary, *sys.argv[1:]])
